about: The named partner in Bruce A. Hagen, Attorney at Law, Bruce Hagen has extensive experience in multiple areas of personal injury litigation such as motor vehicle accident, catastrophic injuries, drunk driving accidents, construction and logging accidents, medical malpractice, spinal cord and traumatic brain injuries, pedestrian and bicycle accidents, and product liability cases, including those that involve defective or dangerous drugs. For the past 30 years, he has assisted in more than 6,000 cases at both the trial and appellate levels.

Mr. Hagen earned his Juris Doctor from George Washington University. Since 1986, he has dedicated his career to assisting more than 10,000 victims in personal injury cases. He is a member of the DeKalb County and Fulton County bar associations, the American Association for Justice and the Georgia Trial Lawyers Association. He has given lectures on personal injury law at dozens of seminars and has made television and radio appearances. Mr. Hagen is also active in his community. He previously served as president of the North Springs High School Athletic Association and the Sandy Springs Youth Football and Cheerleading Association. He currently serves as an announcer for North Springs home football games.

Mr. Hagen operates out of the beautiful, historic Marble House in Decatur, Georgia. He represents clients throughout Georgia including those in DeKalb, Fulton, Gwinnett, Cobb and Clayton counties. He is admitted to practice in the United States District Court for the Northern District of Georgia, the United States Court of Appeals for the 11th Circuit and the state courts of Georgia.
